name: Vaultwarden
description: Lightweight self-hosted password manager (Bitwarden-compatible). Open the admin panel with the token below to invite your first account.

configFields.label: Admin panel token
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Unlocks /admin, where you invite your own account.

connection.title: Set up Vaultwarden
connection.description: Public sign-up is disabled. Open the admin panel with the token below, invite your own email address, then register that address in any Bitwarden client.

outputs.label: Admin panel
outputs.help: Paste the admin token below to sign in, then use Invite User.

outputs.label: Vault URL
outputs.help: Point the Bitwarden app/extension at this as its self-hosted server URL.

outputs.label: Admin token
outputs.help: Full control of the server. Treat it like a root password.

firstLogin.note: Invitations work without SMTP: after inviting your address in /admin, register that same address from the vault URL to set your master password.
